senses.en_definition: A third-person pronoun attached to the preceding word, meaning him, her, it, his, her, or its, depending on the context.
A suffix that makes a word other than a noun function as a noun, referring to an event, process, or quality.

collocations.en: the arrival of the rainy season

senses.en_definition: A suffix that adds emphasis, especially to an adjective expressing degree or an exclamation.
A shortened form of punya used in some informal speech to indicate possession.
The name of the Jawi letter ڽ, representing the palatal nasal sound /ɲ/, written ny in Romanized Malay.

messages.en: Have you tried the nasi lemak I bought you earlier?
Yep. This nasi lemak is so good! Is there any more? I'd love another helping.
You can really see the difference in your room. It looks so much more spacious now.
I just moved the desk. Everything else is still in the same place.

senses.en_definition: Life; the vital force that keeps a person or animal alive.
A dearly loved person; a beloved, especially in poetry or affectionate address.

messages.en: I'm running a bit late. I'm thinking of riding a bit faster. You guys are there already, right?
Hey, no need to rush. You only get one life. We'll wait for you.
Okay, I'll take it slow. I'll message you when I get there.
In this formula, H₂O, the O is the symbol for oxygen, right?
Yes, the teacher explained that earlier. Remember to use a capital O.
